body: T11a — the schema layer, first slice of the T11 umbrella (architecture contract: .adlc/specs/T11.md; spine pins 1-11: deltas-as-events, entities-as-resolutions, primitives-ride/composites-point, schemas-as-deltas). Owns AC2 (the delta vocabulary pinned in a genesis hyperschema+schema set: Session, SubmittedPrompt, InferenceRequested, ResponseDelta, ToolCall, ToolResult, ConversationSummary, MemoryEntity, MemoryEdited + T10 infra types) and AC7 (validation at admission: a delta declaring a known lifecycle type is validated against its schema — ill-shaped refused, reject-never-repair; unknown types admitted raw and never saturate typed handlers) plus the AC10 gates. Deliverables: Kyber.Schema (the schema container actor = resolution authority: holds the compiled set, subscribes to schema deltas for live evolution, answers validate/1 and resolve/1 -> typed objects) and the genesis schema deltas as committed data. Codegen of Elixir structs from schema deltas is DERIVED convenience, never the authority. Gate: schema tests green (vocabulary fixtures validate; malformed refused; unknown admitted raw; resolve returns typed objects); rails-guard clean; format/warnings clean; no Process.sleep.
title: T11a: the schema layer — genesis schema deltas, the schema container actor, validation at admission
